Pages.title: 生菜
Pages.text: $(bold)$(l:tfc:core_mechanics/climate#temperature)温度$(): -6°C - 24°C$(br)$(bold)$(l:tfc:food/hydration)湿度$(): 15 - 75 %$(br)$(bold)类别$(): 蔬菜类$(br2)$(bold)$(3)氮$(): 60 $(bold)$(6)磷$(): +20 $(bold)$(d)钾$(): +20$()$(br2)生菜是单格作物。含水量很高，同时补充水分与蔬菜营养。$(br2)生菜种子可以种植在$(l:tfc:food/farmland)农田$()上，成熟后收割可以得到$(thing)生菜$()和$(thing)生菜种子$()。$(br2)

Pages.title: 马齿苋
Pages.text: $(bold)$(l:tfc:core_mechanics/climate#temperature)温度$(): 10°C - 38°C$(br)$(bold)$(l:tfc:food/hydration)湿度$(): 20 - 70 %$(br)$(bold)类别$(): 蔬菜类$(br2)$(bold)$(3)氮$(): 40 $(bold)$(6)磷$(): 20 $(bold)$(d)钾$(): 30$()$(br2)种子（侧芽）播在$(l:tfc:food/farmland)农田$()上。莲座分六龄生长，完全成熟并显现中心结果态后，破坏整株采收并返还1至2份侧芽；空手右键不采摘。枯死时在原地返还1份对应侧芽，应及时拾取；之后破坏共享死株不再掉落。$(br2)

Pages.title: Purslane
Pages.text: $(bold)$(l:tfc:core_mechanics/climate#temperature)Temperature$(): 10°C - 38°C$(br)$(bold)$(l:tfc:food/hydration)Hydration$(): 20 - 70 %$(br)$(bold)Category$(): Vegetable$(br2)$(bold)$(3)Nitrogen$(): 40 $(bold)$(6)Phosphorous$(): 20 $(bold)$(d)Potassium$(): 30$()$(br2)Sow seeds (sidebuds) on $(l:tfc:food/farmland)farmland$(). This rosette has six leaf stages. Once fully grown with a ripe centre, break the whole plant to harvest and receive one to two sidebuds; an empty-hand right-click does not harvest. When it dies, one species sidebud drops immediately: collect it promptly. Breaking the shared dead plant gives nothing further.$(br2)
